prompt: Which repeat would best show whether the metal plate itself was rattling?
promptZh: 哪種重做方式最能檢驗是不是金屬板本身發出喀啦聲？

options.text: Secure the plate from below without lowering it; keep the trolley, its tray and the lift load unchanged.
options.zh: 從下方固定金屬板，但不降低板面；手推車、托盤與升降台的貨物都不變。
options.whyZh: 固定從下方進行，不讓板子振動，但輪子仍會撞過同樣的凸起。保留原車、托盤與貨物，就能比較固定金屬板前後的聲音，而沒有一併排除托盤受震發出的聲音。

options.text: Cover the threshold with the ramp; keep the trolley, its tray and the lift load unchanged.
options.zh: 把坡板架在門檻上；手推車、托盤與升降台的貨物都不變。
options.whyZh: 雖然保留搬運路線，坡板也避免輪子撞上凸起。若沒有聲音，仍分不清是板子沒受撞擊，還是托盤沒受震。

options.text: Secure the plate from below and take off the trolley tray; keep the route and lift load unchanged.
options.zh: 從下方固定金屬板並拆下手推車托盤；搬運路線和升降台的貨物不變。
options.whyZh: 從下方固定能保留凸起，但是同時拿掉托盤，兩個可能的發聲來源一併消除，不能知道哪項改動使聲音消失。

options.text: Move the trolley to the yard route; leave the tray, the plate at the entrance and the lift load unchanged.
options.zh: 讓手推車改走院子；托盤、入口金屬板及升降台的貨物都不變。
options.whyZh: 改走院子同時避開了金屬板和原本的凸起，不能分辨是板子不響，還是托盤沒有因輪子撞到凸起而發出聲音。

explanationZh: 固定從下方進行，不讓板子振動，但輪子仍會撞過同樣的凸起。保留原車、托盤與貨物，就能比較固定金屬板前後的聲音，而沒有一併排除托盤受震發出的聲音。
evidence: I heard the rattle while the platform stood still, just as he went over the raised metal threshold. / It can rattle against the trolley frame when the wheels strike a raised edge; it was in place in both runs. / The yard route avoids the raised edge altogether. / with the lift carrying the same load and with the trolley trip still part of the work. / That would stop the plate moving but leave its top surface at the same height. / it keeps the wheels from striking the raised edge.

vocabulary.note: 物體發出的快速碰撞響聲。
